statement: Counter-example: counting a rule the checker cannot evaluate as a rule evaluated with no violation -- an implicit pass. The mirror error, reporting it as a failure, is also forbidden.

declared_rules.detail: Files under src/queue/ must be cited by a decision.
No direct import of the legacy client module.
Handler behaviour must remain equivalent across the refactor.

reason: `rules: 3` with an empty violations list tells a reader that three rules were checked and all three held, when one was never evaluated at all. Reporting it as a violation is the opposite lie and additionally fails the run. Silence about an unimplementable rule is honest; a pass is not.
